request.style: English, solo female voice with warm folk choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, piano, upright bass, gentle percussion, reflective and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was lifted from the deep place
You did not let them gloat
I cried out for your help
And you healed my broken soul

[Verse]
You brought me from the dead
Kept me alive from the pit
I stand here by your grace
Your mercy is my only light

[Chorus]
Sing to the Lord his faithful ones
Give thanks to his holy name
His anger lasts but a moment
His favor a lifetime

[Pre-Chorus]
Weeping may spend the night
But joy comes in the morning
The darkness fades away
When the light starts returning

[Chorus]
Sing to the Lord his faithful ones
Give thanks to his holy name
His anger lasts but a moment
His favor a lifetime

[Bridge]
When I felt secure I said
I would never be shaken
But when you hid your face
My heart was filled with terror

[Outro]
Joy comes in the morning
Joy comes in the morning
